conflictLedger.conflict: The implementation maps Play, Journey, Matches, Build, and Identity to character or campaign images and then obscures them under a nearly opaque shell. They do not operate as a coherent Gauntlet background set.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Generate five universal C-30 shell plates, bind one to each destination, reuse them on matching subpages, and keep the UI readable through controlled overlays rather than hiding the art.

globalVisualGrammar.factionAuthority: Universal Gauntlet. No faction or civilization governs these five assets.
globalVisualGrammar.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Modern tactical arena infrastructure: blackened steel, charcoal composite, worn graphite, bone enamel, restrained brass, signal orange/red/yellow, lane geometry, gates, shields, damage marks, boundary rails, and compact control hardware.
mustPreserve: dark central field for application UI
strong visible environmental detail in the top and side gutters
desktop cover crop and centered mobile cover crop
mustAvoid: medieval crests, castles, heraldry, or manuscript styling
poker chips, casino tables, suits, or gambling-room imagery
faction characters, faction architecture, or civilization lore
readable text, fake lettering, logos, UI panels, card faces, or watermarks
